scope: The one authorized genuine SparseUnetVaeDecoder CPU load, strict payload integrity, lossless widening, release, and supervised containment. This does not qualify a neural forward, native kernel computation, O-Voxel child, or mesh workflow.

genuine_load_and_integrity.integrity_basis: The unchanged strict loader compares every assigned CPU tensor's bytes against its cloned original loaded payload and records all 292 original payload hashes. The unchanged Shape loader compares all 76 F32 tensors converted back to F16 against their original F16 bytes. The independently reviewed output names, shapes, dtypes, widening keys and hash linkage all match.
genuine_load_and_integrity.inherited_checkpoint_row_caveat: The checkpoint row retains deserialized=false and an older bounded-header limitation from its inherited audit record. These are not the actual loading result: freshly_streamed_sha256 records the current full hash, and decoder_diagnostics.weights_loaded=true plus the complete final tensor records document this successful load.

release_and_computation_bounds.release_basis: The actual worker clears its model/factory references, calls the existing component unload method, collects garbage, and requires all model, component and parameter weak references to be dead.
release_and_computation_bounds.gpu_context_note: GPU initialization is false before admission and true after the authorized device metadata admission. Metadata queries and synchronization are permitted; the zero counters here concern GPU tensor allocator bytes and prohibited native kernel computation.

measurements.timing_note: The timed existing factory is included in strict_load_and_widen_seconds; these durations must not be added together. The factory timing includes its existing verification and metadata preparation.
measurements.memory_note: Peak RSS is the process high-water mark, including imports and loading. Remaining process RSS after weak-reference collection includes runtime/library state and is not a surviving model claim.

containment_and_monitoring.clock_note: Host and guest monotonic clocks and wall-clock samples have different origins/skew. Their local phase order is reviewed independently.

preservation_review: Not certified by this outcome review; the root task is completing the separate passive after-preservation and final report checks.
minimal_next_action: Finish passive preservation and publish the bounded successful loading report. No additional model attempt, runtime repair or forward is required or authorized by this review.
